<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="pool" name="Small Claims Registry Operations" processRef="proc" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="proc" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="lanes">
      <bpmn:lane id="party" name="Party">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>send</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="office" name="Client Service Back Office">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>receive</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>retrieve1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>forward</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>store1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>report</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>retrieve2</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>attach</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>store2</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Warrant release needed" />
    <bpmn:task id="send" name="Send the warrant possession request" />
    <bpmn:task id="receive" name="Receive the request" />
    <bpmn:task id="retrieve1" name="Retrieve the SCT file" />
    <bpmn:task id="forward" name="Forward the SCT Warrant Possession to Queensland Police" />
    <bpmn:task id="store1" name="Store the SCT physical file" />
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="report" name="Report received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="retrieve2" name="Retrieve the SCT file" />
    <bpmn:task id="attach" name="Attach the new SCT document" />
    <bpmn:task id="store2" name="Store the expanded SCT physical file" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="SCT file passed to MC internal staff" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="send" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="send" targetRef="receive" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="receive" targetRef="retrieve1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="retrieve1" targetRef="forward" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="forward" targetRef="store1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="store1" targetRef="report" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" sourceRef="report" targetRef="retrieve2" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" sourceRef="retrieve2" targetRef="attach" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" sourceRef="attach" targetRef="store2" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f10" sourceRef="store2" targetRef="end" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
